note: Adapted from the species description of Acorhinotermes claritae by Castro Torres & Scheffrahn (2019), originally in English; only the minor soldier and the alate nymph are recorded, no alate description is available, and the major soldier may be absent; measurement-table headings, figure numbers, distribution and ecological records are not translated.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head capsule with the lateral margins concave, forming a constriction posteriorly; mandibular apical processes conspicuous, extending beyond the fontanelle. Compared with A. subfusciceps, the species is smaller and the mandibular apical processes are longer; in lateral view the vertex, the top of the head and the dorsal surface of the labrum form an almost straight line, whereas in A. subfusciceps this profile forms an obtuse angle. The labrum is also less deeply bifurcate apically than in A. subfusciceps.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule in dorsal view with the lateral margins concave, the posterior constriction bearing 10–12 long, straight setae and no microsetae. Antennae 15- or 16-segmented, segment formula 2=3<4=5. Mandibles reduced, the apical processes long, straight and pointed. Labrum much elongate, widening toward the apex, apically bifid, in lateral view almost in the same plane as the vertex; fontanelle situated at one-fifth of the labral length from its base. Pronotum concolorous with the head, with 4–8 scattered setae, 2–4 on the anterior margin and 2–4 on the surface, without microsetae. Abdominal tergites pale yellow, the margins covered with a dense hair layer. Legs with numerous long and short setae, the setae of the fore tibia stout. Measurements: maximum head width 0.45–0.66 mm; head length (including labrum) 1.18–1.40 mm; labrum length 0.57–0.73 mm; pronotum width 0.39–0.56 mm, length 0.24–0.37 mm; hind tibia length 0.77–0.93 mm.

sections.label: Nymph
sections.text: Head capsule yellowish brown, broadly oval, with numerous long setae. Antennae 20-segmented, segment 2 shorter than segment 3, segments 3 and 4 equal in length. Body dorsum concolorous with the head capsule. Compound eyes nearly circular, the ocular margin wide, distant from the antennal socket. Ocelli small, oval, clearly separated from the compound eyes. Clypeus tongue-shaped, without a frontal process supporting it. Pronotum with numerous long setae on the margins, the lateral margins rounded. Mandibular M1 more projecting than the apical tooth; the M1 of the right mandible more projecting than that of the left; the projecting length of the left M2 about half that of M1, M2 and M3 forming an obtuse angle, M3 and the molar tooth projecting equally far. Measurements: head length (including labrum) 1.27 mm; head width (including compound eyes) 1.39 mm, 1.21 mm excluding the compound eyes; compound eye diameter 0.25 mm; ocellus diameter 0.08 mm; pronotum length 0.78 mm, width 1.36 mm; body length (excluding wings) 6.81 mm.
